purpose: Storyboard-first production board for the next approved Episode 1 rebuild. The current generated media is a rejected scratch pass.
animationRule: Every combat, transformation, reveal, or power beat must include a start pose and an action or impact pose before Seedance animation. Static poster frames are blocked.

panels.title: Trinidad Wakes
panels.actionStart: Kai moves through a waking Trinidad street toward the doubles cart.
panels.actionImpact: Traffic rhythm and street sound subtly pull toward Kai without him noticing.
panels.actionEnd: Kai reaches the cart, still unaware the rhythm has selected him.
panels.fx: Warm dawn dust, tiny gold pulse under street noise
panels.qcGate: Kai must match approved sheet; no signs, shop text, labels, or generated lettering.

panels.title: Doubles Before Destiny
panels.camera: Comedic push-in from food to Kai's foot
panels.actionImpact: A gold pulse snaps under his sneaker and interrupts the joke.
panels.fx: Small orange ring under foot, dust lift
panels.qcGate: No readable cart signage or wrapper text.

panels.title: Mother Lall's Warning
panels.camera: Tight insert, rack focus from spoon to eyes
panels.actionStart: Mother Lall folds a coded sigil into a wrapper.
panels.actionEnd: Her eyes warn Kai before the adults explain anything.
panels.qcGate: Sigil must be abstract glow, not readable letters.

panels.title: The Listening Bois
panels.camera: Low-angle push toward hand and staff
panels.actionImpact: The Listening Bois wakes and pulls rhythm into his palm.
panels.actionEnd: Kai recoils as the gayelle threshold forms.
panels.fx: Wood-vein glow, dust lift, orange pulse
panels.qcGate: Staff geometry, beads, wraps, scale, and Kai hand structure must stay correct.

panels.title: First Pulse Knockback
panels.camera: Side track with low impact angle
panels.actionStart: Kai loses balance as the staff rolls toward him.
panels.actionEnd: His hand catches the staff by instinct.
panels.fx: Gold/orange ring, dust burst, no face-covering effects
panels.qcGate: Readable body mechanics; no stiff poster pose.

panels.title: Nia Breaks Fear
panels.camera: Medium push-in to full-body vocal release
panels.actionStart: Nia inhales while fear static closes in.
panels.actionImpact: She shouts a lavway command that breaks the wave.
panels.actionEnd: Gold sound ribbons clear space around the heroes.
panels.fx: Gold ribbons, cracked black static, visible mouth and eyes
panels.qcGate: No text-shaped sound waves or lyric-like marks.

panels.title: Mother Lall Blocks Silence
panels.camera: Fast insert into locked medium hero pose
panels.actionStart: Black silence slash enters from offscreen.
panels.actionImpact: Mother Lall intercepts it with a serving spoon.
panels.actionEnd: She holds the block with a calm glare.
panels.qcGate: No slash covering her face or spoon contact point.

panels.title: Kai vs Malik Exchange
panels.actionStart: Malik steps in with precise red/black Rhythm Break strike.
panels.actionImpact: Kai blocks with accidental gold Tempo Pulse and stumbles into a low sweep.
panels.actionEnd: Both fighters separate with Papa's cane about to interrupt.
panels.fx: Red/black line, gold block pulse, clean weapon contact
panels.qcGate: One readable strike/block/sweep only; no spinning clutter.

panels.title: Stillwater Command
panels.actionEnd: Stillwater silhouettes kneel without readable symbols.
panels.qcGate: Villain must match Marius sheet; no readable cult text or generic armor.

panels.title: Final Cliffhanger
panels.camera: Match-cut split frame into locked stare
panels.actionImpact: Kai hears the impossible silent drumbeat.
panels.actionEnd: Gold/sea-blue pulse answers black ring on unresolved stare.
panels.qcGate: No title/logo/text in image; CTA added later in editor only.
